regime_context: The detector shows a broad, trend-positive leadership structure concentrated in Canadian precious metals — Gold Miners lead with strong durability (0.85), full breadth (1.0), and no crowding; Silver & Royalties sit in the challenger slot. The validated edge here is drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate (which helps on this market's history), NOT return forecasting. Track record shows 59% hit rate but only 32% directional accuracy on 44 calls — small sample, lean low.
emerging_watch: Watching Silver & Royalties (ca_silver_royalty) in the challenger slot, score 1.615 with durability_bar 0.77; the observable condition that would retire this watch is Silver & Royalties' score overtaking Gold Miners' score and its breadth holding at 1.0 for two consecutive reads — a confirmed handoff, not yet a call.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are the dominant narrative with the strongest trend-health profile in the book: durability_bar 0.85 (highest), hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0, and no crowding flag (crowding_z 0.95 but crowded=false). The absolute-trend gate validates the discipline of maintaining exposure while the trend is intact — this is the staying-power leg, not a return forecast. The rotation structure shows a confirmed leader with a 0.552 margin over the challenger, not a handoff.
evidence: gate_helps=true (validated risk-control edge on this market)
theses.dissent: Gold Miners' 0.119 10-period return already prices a substantial move; precious-metals leadership often reflects a risk-off or stagflation signal that can reverse sharply if the macro regime (unscheduled_share 0.89 — very news-driven) shifts, and the momentum rank itself has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and lags the S&P/TSX by 8% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks show weak internal cohesion: breadth 0.429 (less than half of constituents participating), durability_bar only 0.52, and mix mixed trend health. Within a broad rotation (frac 0.88) where precious metals command the attention, Financials rank mid-pack and show no leadership character. A durable-trend discipline would avoid adding here; the trend gate that keeps Gold Miners in the book does not offer the same structural support to Banks.
theses.dissent: Banks are a high-carry, rate-sensitive sector and could re-rate sharply if the Canadian rate outlook shifts; low breadth can mean the index is being dragged by a few strong names before a broad catch-up. Underweighting a core TSX sector carries benchmark-risk if the metals trade unwinds.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO outperforms XGD.TO by 6% over a 30-day window and the Bank rank rises above Gold Miners in the next read

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs sit at the bottom of the eligible stack with breadth 0.0 (no constituent participation) and durability_bar 0.46. The absolute-trend gate would not keep this in the book as a positive contributor. Both the trend-health and breadth legs argue against taking exposure here — this is a disciplined avoidance, not a short.
evidence: crowding_z -1.28 (unloved, not a contrarian buy signal)
theses.dissent: REITs are extremely rate-sensitive and could catch a sharp mean-reversion bid if Canadian long yields fall; extreme low breadth and negative crowding sometimes mark a sentiment trough. However, the detector's own guardrail warns against treating low crowding as a buy trigger, and no confirmed handoff is visible.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO gains over 10% relative to the S&P/TSX and REITs' breadth rises above 0.5 before the check-by date
